intro.title: Build contract tests for API responses
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple contract test to verify that an API response matches an expected structure. You will learn the core concept of contract testing, which ensures that an API's output adheres to a predefined format or 'contract.' The main technologies involved are Node.js, the built-in 'assert' module for validation, and a mock API response. This beginner-friendly project will help you understand how to write tests that catch breaking changes in APIs.
intro.usecase: Contract tests for API responses are essential in real-world applications like e-commerce platforms where multiple services (product catalog, inventory, payment) must communicate reliably. When a frontend dashboard displays user order history, it depends on consistent response structures from the order service API. Without contract tests, backend changes could break the dashboard's ability to parse order dates or amounts, causing display errors for users. These tests ensure that API updates don't unexpectedly break integrations between microservices or between mobile apps and their backend APIs.
